name: Cognism
description: Cognism is a B2B sales intelligence platform built around phone-verified contact data, buying-intent signals, and CRM enrichment, with a compliance-first data-sourcing approach aimed at European and global prospecting.
best_for: Sales and RevOps teams, especially those prospecting into Europe, that prioritize compliance-vetted, phone-verified contact data over the largest possible raw database.
features: Phone-verified mobile numbers (Diamond Data) validated by a manual research team
Buying-intent, hiring, job-change, and funding signals, including data partnerships with Bombora and CB Insights
CRM enrichment that prioritizes data gaps by ICP segment and auto-enriches inbound leads
Data-as-a-Service delivery via real-time API access or scheduled batch exports
Automatic suppression against Do-Not-Call and TPS registries across 15+ countries
Exports and integrations to Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, and other CRM platforms
Seat-based Standard and Pro plans, each including 5 seats, on a per-contact credit system

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: 5 seats included. For teams that need core prospecting workflows. Credit-based contact reveals; personalized quote only, no public price.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: 5 seats included. For teams that need advanced prospecting workflows. Personalized quote only, no public price.

pros: Certified for ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 (UKAS-accredited body) and attested for SOC 2 Type II, per its security page
States GDPR/UK GDPR and CCPA compliance, plus Do-Not-Call/TPS suppression screening across 15+ national registries
Phone-verified "Diamond Data" mobile numbers reviewed by a manual research team rather than automated verification alone
cons: No published self-serve pricing or numeric plan cost; the pricing page offers only a personalized quote
No free trial is offered, only a free data sample, unlike some competitors' time-limited trials
Standard and Pro plans both include only 5 seats by default, with additional seats presumably requiring a custom quote

faq.question: Does Cognism publish its pricing?
faq.answer: No. Cognism's pricing page names two plans, Standard and Pro (each with 5 seats included), but does not publish numeric prices; it directs prospects to request a personalized quote.

faq.question: Is Cognism GDPR compliant?
faq.answer: Cognism states it collects and processes data under the GDPR's legitimate-interest lawful basis (Section 6.1(f)) and commits to notifying clients of a security incident within 72 hours, per its compliance page.

faq.question: What is Cognism's Diamond Data?
faq.answer: Diamond Data is Cognism's phone-verified mobile number service, which its compliance page describes as manually validated by a dedicated research team.

alternatives.name: Apollo.io
alternatives.description: A sales intelligence and engagement platform combining a B2B contact database with sequencing, a dialer, and AI-assisted prospecting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want published self-serve pricing and a bundled dialer/sequencing layer alongside contact data.

alternatives.name: ZoomInfo Sales
alternatives.description: A B2B sales intelligence product combining a large contact/company database with buyer intent, website-visitor tracking, and conversation intelligence.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want the largest published contact/company database alongside intent data and conversation intelligence.
